messages:
lina: Heads-up: planning catalog enable for venice-7b-v1 tomorrow in the 19:00-20:30 PT change window. This is a new major variant (optimized attention kernels). Proposed rollout: 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 60% over ~15-20m steps. Posting proposed fallback ordering and rollback gates, asking for signoff.

jen: ACK for schedule, infra good for slots. What are the fallbacks if quantized variant OOMs?

lina: Fallback ladder: 1) venice-7b-v1-quant (primary) 2) venice-7b-v1-fp16 (same weights) 3) venice-7b-legacy-7b (older model). We'll prefer variants that preserve KV cache compatibility to avoid cold-starts.

omar: Nice. Suggest we also include a regional fallback preference: EU -> use fp16 sooner if quant queues in EU exceed 70% utilization.

lina: Added regional tilt rule: if any region's GPU queue > 70% and p90 latency up > 100ms, route that region to next fallback variant automatically.

deploybot: deploybot: preflight ok. Scheduling enable for 2024-06-21T19:00:00-07:00. Stages: 1%, 5%, 20%, 60%. Canary window 12m per stage. Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/venice7b-cutover. Use `deploybot watch 1722223333` to follow progress.

jen: Rollback triggers I'd propose: sustained p95 latency increase > 120ms for 10m, error spike >1% for 5m, or production-quality regression (BLEU/ROUGE) >4% on the seeded set. Also cost-per-token >25% delta should flag but not auto-rollback; instead pause and investigate.

omar: +1 but make cost auto-pause at >40% because cost oscillations caused outages before.

lina: Agree to combine: cost >40% => auto-pause; cost 25-40% => pause and 10m manual review. Updating runbook.

qa-bot: qa-bot: Pre-cutover test report: seedset run (200 prompts) shows parity vs legacy with small variance (median BLEU -0.6%). See https://qa.internal/venice7b-report. Recommend keep quality gate enabled.

lina: Good. Observability gates: (1) telemetry p95/lossless traces, (2) seedset quality check every stage, (3) regional queue depth, (4) token-cost delta. We'll fail-if any quality gate drops >3.5%.

omar: Make sure the KV cache warm path is invoked before the 20%->60% jump. Suggested procedure: after 20% hold for 8m and run `tools/kv_warm.py --model venice-7b-v1 --sample-rate 0.2` for 6m.

lina: Noted. I'll add the warm script step. Also adding the exact rollback CLI to runbook: ```
# rollback to previous pinned model
curl -X POST "https://catalog.redwood.internal/v1/pin" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"venice-7b-legacy-7b","percent":100,"reason":"rollback-1722223333"}'
```

lina: And immediate unpin for emergency revert: ```
curl -X POST "https://catalog.redwood.internal/v1/unpin" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"venice-7b-v1","reason":"emergency-unpin"}'
```

deploybot: deploybot: note that automated fallback to fp16 is only supported if model checksum compatibility check passes. Preflight included checksum verification.

omar: We'll watch GPU memory and OOM logs. If OOM rate >0.2% for sustained 3m, trigger auto-fallback to fp16 in that region.

jen: SRE will be onpager for the window. I'll coordinate with support for customer comms if we need to rollback.

lina: Please add a short release note blurb for product: "Venice 7B v1 staged enable: improved latency for multi-turn chat; staged rollout with safety gates. Contact eng-releases for issues." I'll post after first stage.

qa-bot: qa-bot: also attached test vector link: https://qa.internal/testvectors/venice7b-cutover.jsonl

omar: One more: autoscaler thresholds. If queue length increases > 25% for 2 consecutive samples (5m), we pause the next stage. If autoscaler can't provision extra nodes in 8m, rollback to pinned version.

lina: All added. Final checklist: preflight ✅, runbook link ✅, QA ✅, SRE oncall ✅, deploybot queued ✅. Proceeding with scheduled enable. Oncall (jen/@jen) will execute `unpin` if gate trip. Tag product and CS for monitoring.

jen: 👍 I'll be in the window and will unpin if needed. Keep me @mentioned in thread when stage starts.

lina: Thanks everyone. Posting the short release note after 1% goes live, and will follow up with metrics snapshots. If anybody sees anything weird ping me @lina or call the pager.
